AUTHOR: Scoulding, B; Maguire, K; Orenstein, EC
TITLE: Evaluating automated benthic fish detection under variable conditions
DATA: Own net-attached Acoustic and Optical System (AOS) stereo stills, 5 deployments (OP12, OP16, OP19 train; OP24, OP32 test) from July 2019 biomass survey
V_EV: Methods/Evaluation: 'Images were binned at 1 m resolution between the seafloor and 10 m'; 'the density, habitat type, and water turbidity are all variable'
D2: Train on starboard images of OP12/OP16/OP19 (random 80/20 train/val); test on port images of same deployments and on unseen deployments OP24, OP32
D_EV: Datasets: 'Port-side images from OP24 and OP32 were used purely for testing purposes and were not seen at all during the training routines.'
R_EV: Results: 'This dataset represents 5 out of the 14 AOS deployments made during the survey'; Discussion: 'all AOS operations used the same instrument'
C_EV: no statement found (only IoU evaluation thresholds 0.3/0.5; no confidence threshold value or FP/duplicate verification)
E_EV: Fig. 4 / Results: 'setting the IoU threshold lower (IoU = 0.3) allowed the detector to return counts of fish close to the human annotated findings'
ARCH: SSD with ResNet-50 base (GluonCV); DCP pre-processing
METR: AP at IoU 0.3 and 0.5; AP vs density, substrate, altitude; predicted vs ground-truth counts per image
NOTE: Same 2019 survey/camera for all deployments, so per P2 the unseen deployments OP24/OP32 (called 'out-of-domain' by authors) are not external -> R1=N; credited under D (deployment-level hold-out, coded 사이트/서식지). In-distribution test = port images of the same stereo pairs used (starboard) for training; authors note 'trained on the same fish but observed from a slightly different angle' (coded D4=Y). V: altitude (camera-to-seafloor range 2-10 m) stratification is quantitative (V6=Y), but V1 only qualitative ('water turbidity ... variable'); images >10 m altitude discarded as too dark (possible P1). Rule gap (V6=Y with non-quantitative V1) -> chose P. PRE: SSD pretrained on PASCAL VOC (no allowed value) -> NR. NIMG approx = 463 starboard + 463 port + 308 port test. IoU 0.3 vs 0.5 discussed as affecting overlapping detections but no score threshold.
